g.text: J4: jumper 1-2 for BAT1 or 2-3 for BAT2 into an external 5V boost. J5: jumper 1-2 for USB 5V or 2-3 for boost 5V. Never fit both. BAT1 connects only to XIAO underside VBAT; BAT2 positive stays separate. Battery negatives share GND. LED DATA is 3.3V logic: check strip compatibility or use external level shifter.
